buildCommand: node -e "const u=process.env.DATABASE_URL||''; if(!u){console.error('❌ DATABASE_URL not set on Vercel. Set it to a Turso libsql:// URL. Run ./setup-turso.sh locally.');process.exit(1)} if(u.startsWith('file:')){console.error('❌ DATABASE_URL is file:... — does not work on Vercel serverless. Use a Turso libsql:// URL.');process.exit(1)}" && bunx prisma generate && bunx prisma db push --accept-data-loss 2>&1 && bunx tsx scripts/vercel-seed.ts && next build
